title: Mediterranean Blue Cabinet Pull, 3-Inch Center-To-Center, Solid Brass, Cabinet Mount, Allied Brass
description: Finished in Mediterranean Blue, cabinet pull with 3-inch center-to-center mounting, solid brass construction, and cabinet-mount installation for kitchen or bathroom cabinetry, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Overall size 3.9 in L x 1.6 in H x 0.9 in W with 1 in projection; supports up to 2 lb. Traditional style cabinet hardware designed for drawers and cabinet doors; includes cabinet pull and all installation hardware. Available in multiple lifetime designer finishes with corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Limited lifetime warranty. Coordinates with traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures throughout the home. Allied Brass decorative cabinet knobs and pulls collection.
